Keep what feels good, and tell Star what you want to change next. Read the full guide Give your friends a reason to play. Play together. Ask for multiplayer. Star hosts the rooms so you can invite friends to the same game. Give players a score to beat. Ask for a leaderboard so players can compare scores and come back for another run. Publish it. Take it with you. Share a link your friends can play in their browser. Export to itch.io, Windows, or your own files when you want. Build in 3D. Ask for a kart race or a first-person arena and Star builds it in real 3D. It runs in the browser, with no engine to install. 42,000+ games made here. Every one taught the agent something about game feel, collision, and difficulty. First versions play better, and edits land where you meant. Tune it without prompting. Drag sliders to adjust gravity, speed, and spawn rates while the game runs. Star Picks Play what people made. A few games made by Star creators. Finished games often take more than one prompt. Browse all games → 4477 play s Stick Slaughter by Ryze 23 23 1663 play s Moonlit Carnage by Ryze 14 11 306 play s The Crucible by Drax 6 2 Build with other creators. Share your game, find playtesters, and trade ideas in the Star Discord. Join the Discord Common Questions Is Star free? Yes. Playing and sharing any Star game is free for everyone, and you can start building free with Claude Haiku 5.5. When you want to keep building, buy a one-time credit pack or subscribe from $20/month for the best credit rate. Do I need coding experience? No. Describe what the player does, like 'jump between platforms and collect coins'. Star builds a first version you can play and change with follow-up instructions. How long does it take to make a game? A first version usually takes a few minutes. Bigger ideas can take longer. Play it, then tell Star what to change, like 'add enemies' or 'make it faster'. Can I share my games anywhere? Publish your game, then send the link in a message, group chat, or social post. Friends can open it in their browser without installing Star. Do people have to pay to play my game? No. Anyone can play and share your published games free, with no account or plan. Your friends never pay to play what you build. How is Star different from ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor? Star combines a game editor with hosting, multiplayer rooms, leaderboards, and exports. Build and revise your game here, then send friends a playable link. You can also export to itch.io, Windows, or your own files. Can Star make multiplayer games? Yes. Say 'make it multiplayer' and Star hosts the rooms on our servers. No backend setup, no netcode, and the match keeps running when the host closes their tab. Which AI models does Star run? Free accounts build and edit with Claude Haiku 5.5. Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Opus 5.5 are also in the main picker; GPT-6 Luna and other models are under More models. Paid accounts can choose their model, and Star remembers that choice. Credit usage depends on the model and the work requested. What game do you want to play? Start with one idea.
